text: あのね…　わたくし　＊が　みたいの！

patterns.name: 〜たい
patterns.explanation: たい stuck onto a shortened verb means 'want to' do it. The thing wanted often takes が. ＊が　みたい = 'I want to see a ＊'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: の at the end, with だ left off, is a soft and girlish way of explaining what is on your mind. みたいの = 'I want to see it, you see'.
